Purge development artifacts

Usage: mole-linux purge [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --debug          Enable debug output
      --dry-run        Inspect artifacts without sending anything to Trash
      --paths <PATHS>  Comma-separated project roots to scan
      --include-empty  Include empty artifact directories in the inventory
      --yes            Skip the final confirmation before sending selected artifacts to Trash
  -h, --help           Print help
